column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
Grr... I'm going home!
Ah... Hey!
Kirino's mood soured and she departed.
Well, this is better than getting more of her pictures taken... I think.
Huh? What is it?
I-It's awful, Kyousuke-shi!
Saori? What happened?
Don't just 'what happened' me!  There's a huge problem!
Huh? Tell me exactly what happened!
You two are spreading all over the internet at an incredible rate!
Huh?!  What's going on?!
Kiririn-shi's pictures have been posted everywhere!  Such an erotic pose too...
The ones from earlier?!
The expression and pose were very nice! Not to mention that borderline low angle shot...
That's not what I'm interested in!
T-That's right!  And there's one more thing!
There's another thing?!
Talks about the furious beauty who came to the holy land are spreading like wildfire on the forums!
Seems like there are repeated calls for "all-out action"in the thread!
Don't tell me I'm the one that upset her? Gah... I don't understand anything anymore...
Anyways, it's a big deal!
Uh... ah...
You don't sound so good...
I-I'm going to go calm down by myself...
I understand. I'll do whatever I can on this end.
Thanks, I'll leave it with you.
*sigh*...
It's become a huge deal.  Like this, if Dad got wind about this, something terri--
Auggh?!?!
H-Hello...?
Kyousuke?
D-Dad!
Don't tell me, are you at Akihabara?
Hiiii!
So it seems.
It's reached Dad's ears at the speed of light!
If it's like this, it's gotta be because of Kirino!
U-Uh... Dad...
I'll listen to your excuses later. In the meantime, get back here.
But... do not think you will live to see the morning sun.
Ah...
And with that proclamation, he hung up the phone.
With this, it's confirmed that if I go home, I will be scolded.
And it's not just that. My sister's friends would no doubt get angry assuming I was a molester brother.
It's... It's over...
